Marcus, the main contact for the duplicate arrivals on door 6 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell, their Director of Yard Operations. I've replied in your #north-team thread.

Dana noted it in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025: Thea had flagged the duplicates again on the morning shift. The same trailer showed up twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch also added him by hand. Dana was following it up with Thea, and I haven't found a newer contact for this issue.
